title: UI rebuild
description: The rounds of one rebuild of a component from observation: each draft, its judged score or its error, and the model cost of each round and in total.

name.description: The registry item's name in victor-ui.

source.description: The original page, the steps file's url. The item's meta.source.

into.description: Absolute path of the victor-ui repo.

target.description: The score that ends the loop.

passed.description: True when the best round reached the target.

best.description: The highest-scoring round, the one left installed. Null when no round was judged.

costUsd.description: The sum of every round's costUsd.

draft.description: The ui-draft JSON file of this round. Null when ui-draft failed.

diff.description: The page-diff JSON file of this round. Null when the round was not judged.

score.description: page-diff's score. Null when the round was not judged.

error.description: Why the round was not judged: copied text, or an install, typecheck, or recording error that the next round gets as its problem, or a failure that ended the loop.

copied.description: ui-draft's copied text. A round with any is not judged, and the next round gets it as its problem. Empty when ui-draft failed.

costUsd.description: ui-draft's model cost for this round. 0 on a cache hit or when ui-draft failed.
